name: Microsoft Power Automate
tagline: Microsoft Power Automate is a cloud-based workflow automation platform deeply integrated with Microsoft 365 and Azure. AI Builder within Power Automate adds document processing, form recognition, and prediction capabilities so business users can automate complex document workflows without custom development. Teams at organisations already in the Microsoft ecosystem use it to connect Office apps with hundreds of external services.
